assumptions.bandwidth_note: ASSUMPTION with a range, not a point estimate. A new representation is bounded below by the slowest measured affine-Q2 launch (223.4 GB/s at 5 MB) and above by the fastest demonstrated packed GEMV (497.4 GB/s, the LM head). The clean GEMV roof is excluded: nothing packed has been shown to reach it.

does_the_model_use_essentially_all_of_W.answer: YES — the model uses essentially all of W. Centered occupancy of X at 99% variance is 3365–3979 of 5120; F(X) is 1907–3848 of 5120. Held-out SwiGLU error of an activation-weighted rank-r factorization does not cross 10% at any rank whose f16 factors cost less than the incumbent 5347795776 bytes (affordable cap r=617). That is a decisive negative for the low-rank family on this organ.

functional_jacobian_rank.answer: The Jacobian of SwiGLU at visited x, restricted to the 99% variance subspace of X, has numerical rank at rel=1e-3 equal to that subspace to measurement precision — F is locally full-rank on the manifold it visits.

how_many_input_directions.answer: Centered covariance of real post_attn_norm X: effective dim at 90/95/99% variance is per-layer in activation_occupancy_X. 99% mass uses 3365–3979 of 5120 directions.

how_many_output_directions.answer: Centered covariance of F(X): 99% mass uses 1907–3848 of 5120.

raw_vs_activation_weighted_rank.answer: Raw SVD of W_gate / W_up is essentially full: every singular value is within 1% of the largest (numerical rank 5120 at rel=1e-2). Activation-weighted energy concentrates more (90% energy of W_gate on the visited X is well below 5120). That gap is the finding. It is not a 4000-vs-200 collapse: weighted 90% energy is still ~10^3 directions.

anti_fabrication.bytes: Every byte figure is executable_economics.score with a five-field bytes_added ledger (generator, embeddings, residuals, metadata, state). bytes_removed without bytes_added is IncompleteEconomics.
anti_fabrication.rule: report_held_out_error raises if split is not 'hold', if the hold prompt set intersects train, or if alleged hold prompt ids sit on train. A return-flag nobody checks is not a guard.

bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement and no generate gate. Numbers are CPU eigen/SVD decompositions of stored real post_attn_norm X and exact affine-Q2 SwiGLU F(X) from the teacher corpus, plus the packed HGRAVF01 tensors of sealed-3.14. Held-out error is by prompt_id (the corpus split). Rank-r F_hat is SwiGLU with each of gate/up/down replaced by an activation-weighted (or raw-SVD) rank-r map; a linear replacement of F is reported separately and is not F. Byte ledgers go through executable_economics.score (generator + residual + metadata + state). evidence_class is STATIC_ONLY. gpu_authority is false.

0.01.note: Rank is the smallest measured sweep rank whose HELD-OUT factorized-SwiGLU relative error is <= threshold, then the max of those ranks across representative layers. Bytes are that rank stored as f16 factors for all 64 layers, scored by executable_economics (residual=0 because the approximation is lossy; a restoring residual rematerializes W).

objective.F_hat: SwiGLU with gate, up, down each replaced by a rank-r map. A linear replacement of F is a different object and is labeled linear_*.
objective.error: E_x ||F(x) - F_hat(x)|| / E_x ||F(x)|| on held-out prompts
objective.not_optimized: ||W - W_hat||_F (raw SVD) — reported as the comparison
objective.optimized: activation_weighted E_x ||W x - W_hat x||, then SwiGLU

purpose: Empirical functional rank of sealed-3.14 MLP on real (X, F(X)): occupancy of X and F(X), raw vs activation-weighted singular spectrum of W, Jacobian rank on the visited manifold, and held-out output error of rank-r approximations.
what_this_does_not_prove: A generate-gate number or a protected TPS.
That a nonlinear program other than rank-r SwiGLU cannot replace F.
That X equals the sealed residual stream (same claim boundary as the corpus).
